title: Утро после вечеринки  (The Morning After the Party)

scenes.title: Morning with a Surprise
scenes.summary: Max reflects on assembling life's puzzle and wakes up beside Katya looking for his jeans, while Nagiyev complains about sleeping on a small sofa.

scenes.title: Three Empty Bottles
scenes.summary: Katya and Max agree that nothing happened between them, realize neither remembers the night, and wonder where they got three bottles of liquor.

scenes.title: Chaos at the Bar
scenes.summary: Kostya and Ainura clean up shattered cognac at the bar and count three broken bottles and three stolen ones as Max arrives.

scenes.title: Chef Looks for Morning Beer
scenes.summary: A hungover Chef Barinov asks Kostya for beer and coffee, learns the bar was trashed and the coffee machine is broken, and suggests checking the server room cameras.

scenes.title: Coffee in Bed
scenes.summary: Vika admits she and Nagiyev still haven't slept together, and when Nagiyev hints at intimacy, Vika politely says good night.

scenes.title: Advice from the Chef
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov teases Nagiyev about Vika rejecting his advances and tells him that with Vika he needs to ask about marriage and children or wait patiently.

scenes.title: Plan to Intercept the Keys
scenes.summary: Max tells Katya they raided the Claude Monet bar during the night and proposes staging a fake mugging to steal Vika's server room keys.

scenes.title: How to Destroy the Evidence
scenes.summary: Katya shows Max her own plan using a spare key, Nagiyev gets rid of his living room sofa, and Max looks for a way to ruin the server computer.

scenes.title: The Lonely Samurai
scenes.summary: Nagiyev tells Vika he ruined the sofa with a cigarette and red wine so he can join her in the bedroom, where Vika asks if he wants children after marriage.

scenes.title: Calling the Repairman
scenes.summary: Max learns the camera company can restore the flooded footage and overhears Vika telling the technician to ask for Kostya at two o'clock, while Chef Barinov teases Nagiyev.

scenes.title: False Alarm and Cognac
scenes.summary: Katya lures Kostya outside to look at her motorcycle while Max pretends to be Kostya at the bar and gets the repairman drunk on cognac so he leaves without checking anything.

scenes.title: The Coffee Machine Repairman
scenes.summary: The real video surveillance technician arrives for Vika while the tipsy man Max got drunk reveals he only came to fix the restaurant's broken coffee machine.

scenes.title: A Full Confession
scenes.summary: Max tells Katya he got the wrong repairman drunk, and they confess to Vika and Chef Barinov that they broke into the bar because they couldn't remember the night.

scenes.title: Calling Nagiyev and the Video
scenes.summary: Vika calls Nagiyev about the bar damages, and Kostya announces that the restored video proves Max and Katya only took two bottles and didn't trash the bar.

scenes.title: The Real Culprit and the Ring
scenes.summary: The security video reveals Chef Barinov trashed the bar at night, clearing Max and Katya, and Barinov accidentally reveals to Vika that Nagiyev bought an engagement ring.

scenes.title: We Are Not Drinking Like That Anymore
scenes.summary: Vika questions why Nagiyev is suddenly proposing, Chef Barinov yells at the cooks in the kitchen, and Max and Katya promise never to drink like that again.

scenes.title: Vika Breaks Up with Nagiyev
scenes.summary: Max is relieved that nothing happened with Katya, while Vika arrives at Nagiyev's apartment, discovers Kristina in the closet, and calmly breaks up with him.

scenes.title: Kristina in the Closet
scenes.summary: Kristina steps out of the closet and asks what Vika was doing there while Nagiyev recites a calming mantra and learns Kristina brought business documents.

scenes.title: The Resignation Letter
scenes.summary: Kristina tries to convince Nagiyev to sell the restaurant for good money, Nagiyev calls the restaurant his hobby, and Vika hands him her resignation.

scenes.title: Mix the Puzzles and Start Anew
scenes.summary: Max asks Vika if she left Nagiyev, tells her to move back into her own apartment while he returns to Kostya's place, and reflects on starting life's puzzle anew.
